# GEO report: atlas-roadmaps **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 12.58 ÷ 23 × 100 = 55. High = (12.58 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 55. A cap of 40 applies because `robots.txt` blocks a search crawler (Bingbot) from the whole site. Your own policy in `geo.config.json` says search crawlers should be allowed. The score is 40, not 55. The basics are mostly in place, but one `robots.txt` block is shutting Bing out of the whole site. Remove it and the score rises to about 81. The other losses are small, per-page fixes. This is read from code, not measured on a live site. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Stop blocking Bingbot - **Why it matters:** Bing's crawler is told to stay away from every page. Bing's index also feeds several AI search tools, so this works against your own "allow AI search" policy. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:5-6` - **What the code says:** `User-agent: Bingbot` / `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 81/100. This fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014 and lifts the cap: (12.58 + 6) ÷ 23 × 100 = 81. The `GPTBot` block at `public/robots.txt:8-9` matches your `trainingCrawlers: "block"` policy. It is a separate choice and I didn't count it. ### 2. Point crawlers to your sitemap - **Why it matters:** `public/sitemap.xml` exists, but nothing tells crawlers where it is. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt` (no `Sitemap:` line anywhere in the file) - **What the code says:** the file ends at `Disallow: /` (line 9) - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 89/100 once items 1 and 2 are both done. Add `Sitemap: https://atlasroadmaps.example/sitemap.xml`. ### 3. Give /pricing its own title, description and canonical - **Why it matters:** the page has no metadata of its own. It shows the site-wide title "Atlas" and has no canonical address. - **Where:** `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` - **What the code says:** `export default function Pricing() { return

Pricing

…` (no `meta` export), so it falls back to `app/root.tsx:2`: `{ title: 'Atlas' }` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 94/100 with items 1 to 3 done. It fixes part of GEO-012 and GEO-015. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | `public/robots.txt`, valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access your policy says | Problem | `public/robots.txt:5-6`, Bingbot blocked site-wide | | GEO-014 | Routes are indexable | Problem | 4 of 4 routes blocked for Bingbot (`public/robots.txt:5-6`). No `noindex` on public pages | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical | Problem | `/pricing` has none. `/`, `/features` and `/changelog` are clear (3 of 4) | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | `app/routes/changelog.tsx:5` fetches in `useEffect`. 3 of 4 routes clear | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | no JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap is discoverable | Problem | no `Sitemap:` line in `public/robots.txt`, though `public/sitemap.xml` is valid | | GEO-012 | Title, description and lang | Problem | `/pricing` uses the generic root meta (`app/root.tsx:2`). `lang="en"` is set at `app/root.tsx:5`. 3 of 4 routes clear | | GEO-016 | Routes linked from server-rendered pages | Problem | `/features` is reached only by `app/routes/_index.tsx:9`. `/pricing` and `/changelog` are linked in the nav (2 of 3) | | GEO-017 | Snippet restrictions | Clear | no `nosnippet` or `max-snippet` found | | GEO-002 | Accessibility checks | Clear | read `app/root.tsx` and all 5 routes: no images, no unnamed links | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | not an app | | GEO-010 | llms.txt | Not scored | absent (informational) | | GEO-102 | App structured data | Not scored | none | ## Other problems found - **Features page hidden behind a click handler:** `app/routes/_index.tsx:9`: `
navigate('/features')}>See all features
`. Crawlers don't follow this. Use `` and add it to the nav in `app/root.tsx:7`. - **Changelog is empty in the served HTML:** `app/routes/changelog.tsx:5`: `useEffect(() => { fetch('/api/changelog')…`. Load the entries in a Remix `loader` instead. ## Worth considering - **Back up the integrations claim:** `app/routes/_index.tsx:8`: `Integrates with all the tools you already use.` Naming the actual integrations, ideally on `/features`, gives readers something to quote. - **Pricing without prices:** `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1`: `Plans that grow with your team. Talk to us for a quote.` Add plan names, prices and what each includes, and a way to contact you. - **Thin features page:** `app/routes/features.tsx:1`: `Timelines, sharing and status updates.` One line per feature, or a section for each, would answer what visitors come to learn. - **Site identity:** no JSON-LD exists. `Organization` or `WebSite` data with the name and URL from `geo.config.json` would state who you are in a machine-readable way. - **Sitemap dates:** `public/sitemap.xml:3-6` has no ``. Add dates, especially for the changelog. - **Individual changelog pages:** the changelog is one list (`app/routes/changelog.tsx:6`). Giving each release its own address would make each one linkable. - **Head basics:** `app/root.tsx:6` renders only ``. Add `charset` and `viewport` to the root `meta`, plus social tags (`og:title`, `og:description`). - **Home page title:** the home title and description are fine. The root description duplicates the h1, so you could drop the root default once every route has its own. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **GEO-013, GEO-014 and GEO-011 live checks:** real status codes, redirects and `X-Robots-Tag` headers need a live scan. - **`/api/changelog`:** there is no route for it in this repo, so I can't tell where the data comes from. ## Assumptions - You want AI search tools to find this site, which matches `policy.aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"`. - `/dashboard` is private, and its `noindex` and `Disallow` are deliberate. It isn't linked or in the sitemap, so I left it out of scoring. - I read all 6 files under `app/`, `public/robots.txt`, `public/sitemap.xml`, `geo.config.json` and `package.json`. I covered all 5 routes plus the root layout and nav. I found 0 JSON-LD sources. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-009`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
